pages: The Conflux was not a disaster. It was an experiment, and it was mine. Every Discipline was a vessel. Every vessel needed someone to fill it.
Fire for those who could endure being unmade. Root for those who could bear to be remembered. Dark for those who could wait forever.
And for the ones who would not agree,
When it was done, I did what the Phoenix does. I burned completely. I unwrote myself, so no one could ever do this again.
I did not lose my way through the Conflux. I built it, and then I made myself forget the map.
The terminal on the platform has a log I never opened. Its first line reads:

pages.text: I wonder how many times I have woken up there.
